name: Azad Engineering Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1983, Azad Engineering Limited is a manufacturer of aerospace components and turbines and supplies its products to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) in the aerospace, defense, energy, and oil and gas industries.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview
The company manufactures highly engineered, complex, mission and life-critical high-precision forged and machined components like 3D rotating airfoils and blade portions of turbine engines and other critical components for gas, nuclear, and thermal turbines. [1] It has a portfolio of 1,700 parts and components and 45+ specialized manufacturing processes.[2]

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 33.2% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 7.08 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 9.43% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 179 days.
